# @tansy/multi-tenant

Many tenants on one tansy: organizations with their own members, roles, domains, content, files and limits.

```bash
npm install @tansy/multi-tenant
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the multi-tenant plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/multi-tenant.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
